authority: Contractors License Board, Professional and Vocational Licensing Division (PVL), Dept. of Commerce and Consumer Affairs (DCCA)
cadence: source DB updated every half-hour (per List Builder disclaimer); lists built on demand
notes: The state does license general contractors: licence classes A (general engineering), B (general building) and C (specialty), with an RME/qualifier model. PVL List Builder: $5.00 for 0-100 records, then $0.05 per record, no refunds. Its fields are licence number, name, status (current/forfeited, active/inactive), date first licensed, business address for entity licences only, employment/association, and licence class for contractors only. No individual addresses. The page I fetched carries a banner saying it is a 'TEST site'; the old URL pvl.ehawaii.gov/pvllistbuilder/ 301-redirects to it. The opendata.hawaii.gov dataset 'PVL Search' is only an HTML link to the search tool (last updated 2019-12-12), not data. The free lookup is https://mypvl.dcca.hawaii.gov/public-license-search/, which returned 403 to curl.

authority: Hawaii Real Estate Commission, PVL Division, DCCA
cadence: source DB updated every half-hour; lists built on demand
notes: This is the same PVL List Builder as for contractors, with the same pricing ($5 for up to 100 records, then $0.05 per record). Business address is given for entity licences only. The page shows principal-broker and company associations as 'employment'. The 'TEST site' banner caveat above applies here too.

authority: Idaho Contractors Board, Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses (DOPL)
notes: This is a REGISTRATION, not a licence. Under the Idaho Contractor Registration Act, anyone doing construction over $2,000 must register; the DOPL FAQ says 'The Act requires registration, not licensure.' DOPL licenses electrical, plumbing and HVAC trades separately, and the Public Works Contractors License Board is also under DOPL. The eDOPL portal is a JavaScript app, so I could not establish whether it can export results. DOPL's public-records page says 'most lists can be obtained through the licensee search'. Otherwise lists go by public records request to PublicRecordsRequest@dopl.idaho.gov (https://dopl.idaho.gov/public-records-request/). No bulk file was found. Fields: not established.

authority: Idaho Real Estate Commission (within DOPL)
notes: The REC license-search page is https://dopl.idaho.gov/rec/rec-license-search/, and DOPL's license-search link redirects to eDOPL. Whether eDOPL can export results is not established, since the app needs JavaScript. The records-request route is PublicRecordsRequest@dopl.idaho.gov.

authority: Illinois Dept. of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR), for roofing contractors; Illinois Dept. of Public Health (IDPH), for plumbers and plumbing contractors
approx_rows: approx 34,000 ROOFING CONTRACTOR rows (all statuses; the whole dataset is ~4.29M rows)
terms: free (ODbL, per the dataset's licence metadata)
notes: The state has no GC licence; roofing is the only construction trade IDFPR licenses. The dataset is 'Professional Licensing' (id pzzh-kp68), attributed to IDFPR, filtered on license_type='ROOFING CONTRACTOR'. It has city/state/zip and county but NO street address. It includes historical statuses (NOT RENEWED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED and so on), so filter on license_status. The 'Specialty/Qualifier' column exists, but whether it holds the qualifier's name was not checked. IDPH licenses plumbers and registers plumbing contractors, but only a lookup exists for that (https://plumblicv5pub.dph.illinois.gov/Clients/ILDOHPlumb/Public/Verification/Plumber_License_Verification.aspx). IDFPR's 'Active License Report' page offers monthly PDFs only.

authority: IDFPR, Division of Real Estate
approx_rows: approx 598,000 REAL ESTATE rows (all statuses; roofing + real estate combined had ~92,000 ACTIVE)
notes: Same dataset as the contractor row (pzzh-kp68, 'Professional Licensing'), filtered on license_type='REAL ESTATE'; the 'description' column gives the sub-type. It includes discipline columns (ever_disciplined, case number, action) and city/zip/county, but no street address. Most rows are lapsed, so filter on status.

authority: Indiana Plumbing Commission, Indiana Professional Licensing Agency (IPLA/PLA)
notes: The state has no GC licence. Plumbing is the only construction trade licensed at state level; electrical, HVAC and general contracting are licensed locally by cities and counties. I saw this confirmed only in search-result snippets from in.gov municipal pages, not on an IPLA page, so treat it as a lead. The PLA download service costs $150 for the first record plus $10 per additional 1,000 records. Fields are name, licence number, address, issue date, expiration date and status. The page does not list which professions it covers. Free lookup: https://www.in.gov/pla/license/free-search-and-verify/.

authority: Indiana Real Estate Commission, Indiana Professional Licensing Agency
notes: Same paid PLA download: $150 for the first record plus $10 per 1,000 additional records. The page describes 'individuals and businesses' with active licences and does not name professions, so real estate coverage is assumed from the page's all-PLA scope, not confirmed. The APRA request route is https://in.accessgov.com/pla-apra.

authority: Iowa Dept. of Inspections, Appeals, & Licensing (DIAL), Contractor Registration (formerly the Iowa Division of Labor)
file_format: Iowa Data Hub dataset (download button; export format not established)
notes: This is a registration (Iowa Code ch. 91C), not a competency licence; it is required at $2,000/yr or more of construction. The dataset is 'Active Iowa Construction Contractor Registrations' (alias active_construction_contractors), ACTIVE registrations only. Columns: registration number, company name, individual first/last name, address lines 1-2, city/state/zip, phone, email, county, issue_date, expire_date, and primary_activity (a NAICS activity, which serves as the trade). data.iowa.gov has moved off Socrata, so the old id dpf3-iz94 and its /resource and /api/views URLs now return 404. Electricians (DIAL Electrical) and plumbing/mechanical (Plumbing & Mechanical Systems Board) are licensed separately, and no dataset was found for them.

authority: Iowa Real Estate Commission, Dept. of Inspections, Appeals, & Licensing (DIAL)
notes: No real-estate licensee dataset exists on the Iowa Data Hub (I searched it); the hub does carry appraisers (dataset 788). DIAL points to the state open-records portal https://iowaopenrecords.nextrequest.com/ for records not available online. Iowa Code 10A.508 makes licensees' private contact info (home address, email, phone) confidential.

authority: Kansas Attorney General (roofing contractor registration only)
notes: There is no state GC licence; general contracting and trades are licensed by cities and counties. The only state-level construction register found is the Kansas Roofing Registration Act (since 2013) registration, held by the Attorney General; general contractors meeting 2015 HB 2254 criteria are exempt. ag.ks.gov returned 403 to WebFetch and curl, so the directory's form and export ability are unverified. That no electrical/plumbing/HVAC trade is licensed at state level comes from non-official sources and is not established.

authority: Kansas Real Estate Commission (KREC)
posted_date: not_established (an indexed copy titled 'Licensee Data Published 8-5-24')
notes: Search-indexed KREC text describes a 'Licensee Data Report': all licensees (Active, Inactive, Suspended, Revoked, Expired, Deceased), CSV, zipped, updated monthly, and not for verification. The krec.ks.gov site returned 403 to every fetch, and HEAD on the zip gave 403 (www) or 404 (bare host), so the file is unconfirmed; fields not established. The lookup is Accela (https://licensing.ks.gov/verification_krec/). Page: https://www.krec.ks.gov/licensees/licensee-and-exam-information.

authority: Kentucky Dept. of Housing, Buildings and Construction (DHBC/HBC), Public Protection Cabinet
notes: There is no statewide GC licence; general contractors are local. HBC licenses electrical, plumbing, HVAC, fire protection (sprinkler/alarm), building inspectors, manufactured housing and UST trades. The HBC licensee search is interactive only, with no export found. Open-records route: Public Protection Cabinet open records (not fetched).

authority: Kentucky Real Estate Commission (KREC), Public Protection Cabinet
notes: The 'Active License Directory' is a search form with filters for board, licence type, region, county and business name, and no export. Verification: https://oop.ky.gov/. The open-records route is the Public Protection Cabinet open records portal linked from krec.ky.gov; contact ppc.krec@ky.gov, 502-564-7760.

authority: Louisiana State Licensing Board for Contractors (LSLBC)
notes: The state does license GCs. There are four licence categories: Commercial (at $50k or more), Residential (at $50k or more), Home Improvement registration ($7,500-$50k) and Mold Remediation, with classifications and subclassifications per the code list (revised 2025-09-05). A 'Request Roster' order form filters by category, type, status and parish and shows 'Order Amount Due'; price, format and fields are not established. Free lookup: https://arlspublic.lslbc.louisiana.gov/Public/Search (searchable by name, number, city, parish, type and qualifying party).

authority: Louisiana Real Estate Commission (LREC)
notes: This is a roster order form (login appears required) that filters by category (Real Estate/Appraisal), licence type, status (Active/Inactive/Pending/Expired), start date and parish, with an 'Order Amount Due'. Price, format and fields are not established. Alternative: public records request at https://portal.lrec.gov/Public/RequestPublicRecords. Lookup: https://portal.lrec.gov/public/search.

authority: Office of Professional and Occupational Regulation (OPOR): Electricians' Examining Board and Plumbers' Examining Board
notes: There is no state GC licence. The Maine AG says 'general contractors - and trades such as roofing and framing - are not licensed or regulated.' LD 1226 (residential contractor licensing) 'Died On Adjournment, Apr 29, 2026' per legislature.maine.gov; third-party sites wrongly report it as enacted, effective 2027. The state licenses electricians and plumbers (and other OPOR trades) through the ALMS query system. ALMS says 'In most cases, you may also obtain a downloadable file of the matching records.' That export comes from a search; whether an unfiltered, whole-board export works was NOT tested, so this is closer to query-export than a posted file.

authority: Maine Real Estate Commission, Office of Professional and Occupational Regulation (OPOR), Dept. of Professional and Financial Regulation
notes: The Commission's Online Services page links 'Download a List of Licensees' to this ALMS query (board=4060). ALMS offers a 'downloadable file of the matching records'. I did not test the file's format, fields or whether it covers all licensees. Downgrade to lookup_form_only if a whole-board export turns out not to be permitted.

authority: Maryland Home Improvement Commission (MHIC), Maryland Dept. of Labor, Division of Occupational and Professional Licensing
notes: There is no state GC licence. MHIC licenses home-improvement contractors, subcontractors and salespersons for residential work only (excluding common areas of condos and buildings of 4+ units). A county Circuit Court clerk 'construction license' is a business licence, not a qualification. State boards also license electricians, plumbers and HVACR (all lookup at https://labor.maryland.gov/pq/). No MHIC dataset exists on opendata.maryland.gov (I checked the Socrata catalog) and no export was found. MPIA route: Dept. of Labor, Office of the Secretary, Records Request PIO, 100 S. Charles St, Tower I, 9th floor, Baltimore MD 21201, 410-230-6296 (https://labor.maryland.gov/aboutdllr/mpia.shtml).

authority: Maryland Real Estate Commission, Maryland Dept. of Labor
notes: This is a personal-name search of active licences only, with no export. No dataset exists on opendata.maryland.gov. For bulk data, use the MPIA request to the Dept. of Labor (same route as the contractor row).
